svg.title: Burgundy Mosaic
svg.desc: Animated 2D red hot pepper revealed by 39 square mosaic tiles in deterministic random order. After the pepper completes, the cursive word Chillie is written stroke by stroke.
svg.metadata: Variant 08; seed 8443; 9 by 9 checkerboard mosaic; transparent background. Handwritten Chillie from 1.000s to 1.500s.
